originalTitle: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
title: Where Are Our Dads? A Long, Long Wait in Africa!
content:
Hi everyone! It's your friend, Reporter RoRo, here from our amazing continent of Africa! Today, we have a very important story. It's about some children, just like you, who have been waiting a very, very long time. They are waiting for their daddies.

A Long, Long Time Ago

Imagine when you were just a baby. Or even before you were born! Imagine your mom and dad were young, young people. Well, this story started a super long time ago. It was 25 years ago! That's like going to school from Kindergarten all the way to big, big university, and then some more years after that! Did you know? Twenty-five years is a very, very long time for anyone to wait for someone they love. It's more than half of some grown-ups' whole lives!

Our Country, Eritrea

This story comes from a beautiful country in Africa called Eritrea. Africa is our big continent, full of many different countries, animals, and people! Eritrea is a country that once had a big fight, a 'war,' to become free. When a country is free, it means the people can choose how they want to live and who will help them run their country. The daddies in our story helped Eritrea become free. They were like superheroes for their country! They are called 'war heroes' because they were brave and fought for their country's freedom.

Where Are Our Daddies?

So, 25 years ago, something very sad happened. These brave daddies, who helped Eritrea be free, were taken away. They were put into jail. And since then, no one has seen them. No one knows where they are. This is a big, sad mystery. Can you imagine not seeing your mom or dad for even one day? It feels very strange and makes you worried, right? Now imagine not seeing them for 25 whole years! The children of these daddies have grown up. They were very, very small when their daddies left. Some were even babies. Now, they are grown-ups themselves. But they still don't know where their daddies are or if they are okay. It's like a puzzle with missing pieces for a very long time. They say, 'I don't even know if my parents are alive!' This means they are so sad and worried. They don't know if their daddies are still living or not. It's a very heartbreaking question.

What is a Jail?

Did you know? A jail is a place where people are kept. Sometimes it's for people who have done something wrong. Sometimes, it's because people in charge think they did something wrong. But usually, people in jail get to see their families sometimes. And families know where they are. It's a rule that families should know. In this story, the families don't even know where the daddies are. They don't know what jail they are in. This is very unusual and makes everyone sad and worried.

Why Were They Taken Away?

The daddies were important people who helped the country. They were like helpers for the 'government.' The government is the group of people who make rules and help run a country. We don't really know why they were taken to jail. That's part of the big mystery and why the children are asking so many questions. It's like if you had a secret, and no one would tell you. But this secret is about their own daddies! It makes them feel lost and confused.

Children Want Answers

The children of these daddies are grown up now. But they still feel like little kids who miss their parents. They want to know: Are our daddies alive? Where are they? Can we see them? They are asking for 'answers.' Asking for answers means they want someone to tell them what happened. They want to know the truth. Did you know? Every child deserves to know where their parents are. It's part of feeling safe and loved in a family. Knowing the truth helps you feel a bit better, even if the news is sad.

Why Are Families Important?

Families are super important! They give us hugs, tell us stories, help us with our homework, and teach us how to be kind and brave. They make us feel safe and loved. When a parent is missing, it leaves a big hole in a child's heart. These children have lived with that big hole for 25 years. That's a very long time to feel a big hole in your heart. They miss the simple things: a goodnight kiss, a daddy's joke, someone to listen to their problems. These are things every child needs and cherishes.

What Can We Do?

Even though we are far away, we can understand that this is a sad story. We can hope that these children get the answers they need soon. It's important for everyone to have a voice. Even for children to ask questions when things don't seem right. These children are using their voices to ask for their daddies. Let's hope that soon, these families can find peace and get the truth about their brave daddies. Because everyone deserves to know where their loved ones are. Let's send them warm thoughts from Africa!
summary: Children in Eritrea have waited 25 years to know what happened to their daddies, who were brave war heroes taken to jail long ago.
whyMatters: It is important because every child deserves to know where their parents are and feel safe, and these children have been waiting for answers for a very, very long time without any news.

originalTitle: US, China open high-level talks ahead of Trump-Xi summit
title: Big Countries Talking: Like Friends Playing Together!
content:
Hello, amazing children of Africa! It’s your friend, the news reporter, bringing you exciting news from our big, big world. Today, we have a very important story about two very, very big countries. They are far away from our beautiful Africa, but what they do can sometimes touch us all!

Two Big Friends: The USA and China

Imagine our world is like a giant playground. On this playground, there are many, many children – and these children are like different countries. Some are small, some are big. Today, we are talking about two of the biggest children on this playground: a country called the United States of America, or just the USA, and another huge country called China. They are both very important! The USA is a big country far away, across a giant ocean. It has lots of tall buildings, big cities, and beautiful places. People there speak English, just like many of us do! China is another super-big country, also far away, on the other side of the world. It has a very long history, amazing inventions, and lots of people. **Did you know?** China has the most people in the whole world! Imagine a country with more people than many, many countries put together!

Meet the Leaders

Just like every school has a principal, and every home has parents, every country has a special leader. These leaders help make important decisions for their country and its people. For the USA, the leader is called Mr. Trump. He is a very important person who helps guide his country. And for China, the leader is called Mr. Xi. He is also a very important leader who helps guide his country. These two leaders are like the "head teachers" of their countries! They have big jobs to do every day.

Talking Before the Big Meeting

Now, sometimes, big countries need to talk to each other. It's like when you and your friend want to play a game, but you need to decide which game first, or how to share the toys. The USA and China have important things to talk about. Maybe they want to talk about how to make things like toys and clothes for everyone, or how to help each other, or how to keep the world safe. Before Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi meet, they have special helpers who talk first. It's like sending your little brother or sister to check if your friend is ready to play! These helpers are very clever people. For the USA, a special helper named Scott Bessent went to talk. And for China, a special helper named He Lifeng went to talk. They met in a super big city called New York. New York is in the USA and it has some of the tallest buildings in the world! It's a very busy and exciting place. **Did you know?** Talking is one of the best ways to solve problems! When we talk, we can understand each other better and find good ways to work together.

Why Do These Talks Happen?

Imagine if countries never talked to each other. It would be like living in a village where nobody ever spoke! It would be confusing and difficult. When countries talk, they can become better friends. They can help each other with different things, like sharing ideas for new medicines or helping protect our beautiful planet. These talks are also about trade. Trade means buying and selling things. The USA might sell something special to China, and China might sell something special to the USA. This is important because many of the things we use every day, like our clothes, our shoes, or even some of our toys, might come from these big countries. So, when they talk about trade, it can affect how much things cost or what kinds of things we can find in our shops here in Africa.

The Big Summit!

The special helpers, Scott Bessent and He Lifeng, are talking to prepare for an even *bigger* meeting. This very important meeting is called a "summit." A summit is when the two main leaders, Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi, will meet face-to-face. It's like the main event after all the planning! When leaders meet in person, they can look each other in the eye, shake hands, and really talk through the biggest challenges and opportunities. They will talk about how their countries can work together to make the whole world a better, happier, and safer place for everyone, including all of us here in Africa! **Did you know?** Leaders from African countries also meet with leaders from other parts of the world to talk about how to make life better for African children and families! It's all about working together.

Why This Matters to You

You might think, "Oh, these countries are so far away! Why does it matter to me?" Well, guess what? We are all connected on this big planet Earth! When big countries like the USA and China talk and work well together, it helps make the whole world more stable and friendly. It's like when everyone in your class gets along – the classroom is a much nicer place to be, right? The same is true for our world! When countries are friends, they can help each other, which can sometimes mean better opportunities or more peace for everyone, even in our communities here. So, the talks between the USA and China are super important because they are helping to build bridges of friendship and understanding across the world.

Keep Learning and Sharing!

Isn't it amazing how much happens in our world every day? Even simple talks between helpers can lead to big changes! Let's always remember the power of talking, sharing, and being friends, whether it's on the playground, in our homes, or between big countries. We hope these talks help everyone, all around the globe, live in peace and happiness. That's all for today from your friendly reporter! See you next time for more exciting news!
summary: Special helpers from the big countries of the USA and China are having important talks in New York to get ready for a big meeting between their leaders, Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi, to help the world be friends.
whyMatters: When big countries like the USA and China talk and work together, it helps make the whole world a more friendly and peaceful place, which is good for everyone, including children and families in Africa.
